name: Private School Fees Loan
summary: Pays school fees directly into the school account, repayable over 4 months, up to 3 times net salary.
benefits: Loan of up to 3 times net salary
Loan amount paid directly into the school account
Applicants can apply for any number of children, provided the total does not exceed 3 times net salary
Facility to ease the school fees burden
eligibility: Account holder should have at least one month's salary coming through CBZ Bank
audience: Parents with children in private school
